description: Convx 1.5.3 (Beta r14) introduces a built-in free lyrics translation engine, offline Greek romanization, Classic Player layout and artwork fixes, alongside vital playback and download resilience enhancements.

changelog.title: Lyrics & Translation Engine
items: Integrated built-in free Google Translate engine: lyrics can now be translated out-of-the-box without requiring AI API keys or third-party configurations.
Implemented persistent Room database caching for translations, guaranteeing instantaneous zero-network reloads on subsequent plays.
Added offline Greek (ELOT 743 / ISO 843) lyric romanization with a dedicated toggle switch in Romanization Settings.
Made the lyrics translation toggle universally available and interactive directly within the player transport row and lyrics menu.

changelog.title: Classic Player Refinements
items: Resolved missing album cover issue in Classic Player theme; artwork now renders reliably across all player background styles.
Cleaned up transport control hierarchy by removing redundant repeat and favorite buttons from the primary playback row, keeping Previous, Play (100dp), and Next neatly centered and balanced.

changelog.title: Playback & Download Stability
items: Fixed audio playback freezes and stream stall during network handoffs using safe coroutine timeouts and active watchdog stall arming.
Resolved download progress stall caused by conflicting range query parameters, bolstered by resilient OkHttp connection and read timeouts.

changelog.title: UI & Landscape Ergonomics
items: Eliminated Liquid Glass shader seam cut and visual artifacts when dialing reflection height to maximum values.
Added vertical scrolling support to Sleep Timer and Bluetooth Audio Device sheets, preventing UI cutoff in horizontal/landscape view.
